summary: Preserve explicit Claude harness choices when channel installation fails, and make archive upgrades and running-daemon restart requirements visible without overwriting Nix-owned paths.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Explicit --harness claude and interactive Claude choices now fail with the channel-install error instead of silently selecting another harness. Automatic selection retains its fallback. Archive installers refuse Nix/Home Manager-owned targets and report existing CLI version changes.

downtime.detail: Archive installation still does not restart the daemon. Read-only service-manager status produces a restart reminder for a running managed daemon; unmanaged daemons are outside that probe.

manual.detail: Correct the reported Claude installation or organization-policy error and rerun setup with the same chosen harness. Follow the upgrade guide before replacing archives, then deliberately restart the daemon and inspect its build. Upgrade Nix-owned installations through their existing Home Manager configuration.

recovery.detail: Existing macOS app backups are retained. No state or database rollback behavior changes; an app backup does not undo database migrations.
